Build an animated capybara riding a hoverboard using only HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Deliver a single self-contained HTML file with all CSS and JavaScript inline. Do not use external libraries, external image assets, external fonts, or network requests. Inline SVG, CSS drawing, and canvas are allowed.

The result should visibly show a capybara riding a hoverboard, with animation that makes the scene feel alive. Do not include audio.

Return only the HTML source, without explanations or Markdown code fences.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>Capybara Hoverboard Cruise</title>
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
  }

  html, body {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0d0826;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  }

  #stage {
    position: relative;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  #bg-canvas, #fx-canvas {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
  }

  #bg-canvas {
    z-index: 1;
  }

  #scene-svg {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    z-index: 2;
    pointer-events: none;
    overflow: visible;
  }

  #fx-canvas {
    z-index: 3;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* Subtle HUD & Interactive Controls */
  .hud-top {
    position: absolute;
    top: 18px;
    left: 22px;
    right: 22px;
    z-index: 10;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .brand-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 8px 16px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.58);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    color: #f8fafc;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
  }

  .status-dot {
    width: 9px;
    height: 9px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #00f5d4;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px #00f5d4;
    animation: pulseDot 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  @keyframes pulseDot {
    0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
    50% { transform: scale(1.35); opacity: 0.65; }
  }

  .telemetry {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .stat-card {
    padding: 7px 14px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.55);
    border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    color: #e2e8f0;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    min-width: 96px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .stat-value {
    display: block;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: #00f5d4;
    margin-top: 2px;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }

  .controls-bar {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 20px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 10;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.64);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38);
  }

  .ctrl-btn {
    appearance: none;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    color: #f8fafc;
    padding: 7px 14px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.15s ease, background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .ctrl-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.18);
    border-color: rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.55);
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.22);
  }

  .ctrl-btn:active {
    transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.97);
  }

  .ctrl-btn.active {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.28), rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.28));
    border-color: #00f5d4;
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.32);
  }

  .kbd-hint {
    font-size: 10px;
    padding: 1px 5px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    color: #94a3b8;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .telemetry { display: none; }
    .kbd-hint { display: none; }
    .controls-bar { width: 94%; border-radius: 20px; bottom: 12px; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="stage" title="Click anywhere or press Space to jump!">
  <canvas id="bg-canvas"></canvas>

  <!-- Crisp Vector Capybara & Hoverboard Rig -->
  <svg id="scene-svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 750" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <defs>
      <!-- Capybara Fur Gradients -->
      <linearGradient id="furBodyGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="15%" y2="100%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c98854" />
        <stop offset="48%" stop-color="#a86838" />
        <stop offset="85%" stop-color="#7d4822" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5e3417" />
      </linearGradient>

      <linearGradient id="furHeadGrad" x1="10%" y1="0%" x2="30%" y2="100%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#cf8e59" />
        <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#ae6d3d" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7c4823" />
      </linearGradient>

      <radialGradient id="snoutGrad" cx="68%" cy="45%" r="58%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5e3924" />
        <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#452717" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2c170c" />
      </radialGradient>

      <linearGradient id="bellyHighlight" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e0a979" stop-opacity="0.65" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#a86838" stop-opacity="0" />
      </linearGradient>

      <linearGradient id="legDarkGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#874f28" />
        <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#5c3317" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#381d0b" />
      </linearGradient>

      <linearGradient id="legFrontGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#a66738" />
        <stop offset="68%" stop-color="#75431f" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#42220d" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Yuzu Tangerine Gradients -->
      <radialGradient id="yuzuGrad" cx="35%" cy="30%" r="68%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffe066" />
        <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#ffa928" />
        <stop offset="85%" stop-color="#f07800" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c25200" />
      </radialGradient>

      <linearGradient id="leafGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#7ee081" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2b8a3e" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Scarf Gradient -->
      <linearGradient id="scarfGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="20%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff4d79" />
        <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#ff2a6d" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b5179e" />
      </linearGradient>

      <linearGradient id="scarfStripeGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#00f5d4" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#fee440" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Hoverboard Gradients -->
      <linearGradient id="boardTopGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="15%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#334155" />
        <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#1e293b" />
        <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#0f172a" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#334155" />
      </linearGradient>

      <linearGradient id="boardChassisGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f472b6" />
        <stop offset="22%" stop-color="#e2e8f0" />
        <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#94a3b8" />
        <stop offset="78%" stop-color="#e2e8f0" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#00f5d4" />
      </linearGradient>

      <linearGradient id="boardBellyGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1e293b" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#090d16" />
      </linearGradient>

      <linearGradient id="neonRailGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff2a85" />
        <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#00f5d4" />
        <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#38bdf8" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff2a85" />
      </linearGradient>

      <radialGradient id="thrusterCoreGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff" />
        <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#72efdd" />
        <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#00bbf9" stop-opacity="0.8" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#00bbf9" stop-opacity="0" />
      </radialGradient>

      <linearGradient id="visorGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#00f5d4" />
        <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#38bdf8" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f72585" />
      </linearGradient>

      <radialGradient id="groundGlowGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#00f5d4" stop-opacity="0.65" />
        <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#38bdf8" stop-opacity="0.32" />
        <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#f72585" stop-opacity="0.12" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0" />
      </radialGradient>

      <filter id="neonGlow" x="-40%" y="-40%" width="180%" height="180%">
        <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="5" result="blur" />
        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="blur" />
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
        </feMerge>
      </filter>

      <filter id="softGlow" x="-25%" y="-25%" width="150%" height="150%">
        <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="blur" />
        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="blur" />
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
        </feMerge>
      </filter>
    </defs>

    <!-- GROUND SHADOW & REPULSOR REFLECTION -->
    <g id="ground-shadow-group" transform="translate(600, 585)">
      <ellipse id="ground-neon-pool" cx="0" cy="0" rx="235" ry="34" fill="url(#groundGlowGrad)" />
      <ellipse id="ground-dark-core" cx="0" cy="0" rx="155" ry="16" fill="rgba(5, 8, 22, 0.65)" />
      <ellipse id="ground-thruster-spot-rear" cx="-92" cy="2" rx="46" ry="9" fill="#00f5d4" opacity="0.45" filter="url(#softGlow)" />
      <ellipse id="ground-thruster-spot-front" cx="92" cy="2" rx="46" ry="9" fill="#00f5d4" opacity="0.45" filter="url(#softGlow)" />
    </g>

    <!-- MAIN HOVER RIG (Capybara + Hoverboard) -->
    <g id="rider-rig" transform="translate(600, 440)">
      <g id="trick-spin-group">

        <!-- REAR THRUSTER AFTERBURNER PLUME -->
        <g id="rear-jet-plume" transform="translate(-195, 42)">
          <path id="jet-outer" d="M 10,-10 Q -85,-24 -165,0 Q -85,24 10,10 Z" fill="#f72585" opacity="0.78" filter="url(#neonGlow)" />
          <path id="jet-mid" d="M 12,-7 Q -65,-15 -125,0 Q -65,15 12,7 Z" fill="#00f5d4" opacity="0.92" filter="url(#softGlow)" />
          <path id="jet-core" d="M 14,-4 Q -40,-8 -78,0 Q -40,8 14,4 Z" fill="#ffffff" />
        </g>

        <!-- FLOWING SCARF TAILS (Behind Capybara) -->
        <g id="scarf-tails-group">
          <path id="scarf-tail-back" d="M 55,-72 C -15,-82 -85,-65 -145,-78 C -90,-45 -25,-52 50,-48 Z" fill="#9d174d" />
          <path id="scarf-tail-main" d="M 62,-68 C -10,-72 -90,-48 -165,-58 C -155,-34 -145,-30 -158,-28 C -85,-22 -10,-42 60,-42 Z" fill="url(#scarfGrad)" />
          <path id="scarf-tail-stripe" d="M 56,-56 C -15,-60 -88,-38 -154,-45" stroke="url(#scarfStripeGrad)" stroke-width="4.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.9" />
        </g>

        <!-- CAPYBARA CHARACTER GROUP -->
        <g id="capybara-group" transform="translate(0, 0)">

          <!-- Far-side Back Leg (Left) -->
          <g id="leg-back-far" transform="translate(-96, -15)">
            <path d="M -18,-35 C -36,-15 -34,18 -20,38 L 12,38 C 16,22 14,-15 -2,-35 Z" fill="url(#legDarkGrad)" />
            <!-- Far Back Paw (3 toes) -->
            <path d="M -22,34 C -24,42 -15,45 -6,45 L 18,45 C 25,45 27,37 18,33 Z" fill="#361c0c" />
            <ellipse cx="14" cy="41" rx="6" ry="3.8" fill="#261206" />
            <ellipse cx="4" cy="42" rx="6" ry="3.8" fill="#261206" />
          </g>

          <!-- Far-side Front Leg (Left) -->
          <g id="leg-front-far" transform="translate(56, -18)">
            <path d="M -14,-36 C -22,-10 -18,20 -12,41 L 14,41 C 18,20 16,-12 6,-36 Z" fill="url(#legDarkGrad)" />
            <path d="M -14,37 C -16,45 -6,47 6,47 L 24,47 C 31,47 32,39 22,35 Z" fill="#361c0c" />
            <ellipse cx="20" cy="43" rx="6" ry="3.8" fill="#261206" />
            <ellipse cx="9" cy="44" rx="6" ry="3.8" fill="#261206" />
          </g>

          <!-- CAPYBARA TORSO / BODY -->
          <g id="capy-torso">
            <!-- Little Rump Fur Tufts -->
            <path d="M -138,-68 L -150,-75 L -142,-60 L -154,-61 L -142,-48 Z" fill="#8d532a" />

            <!-- Main Plump Barrel Body -->
            <path d="M -142,-58
                     C -148,-108 -104,-146 -42,-148
                     C 18,-150 65,-138 92,-112
                     C 112,-92 114,-48 96,-18
                     C 78,4 28,10 -32,8
                     C -96,6 -136,-12 -142,-58 Z"
                  fill="url(#furBodyGrad)" />

            <!-- Soft Warm Belly Highlight -->
            <path d="M -105,-22 C -50,2 25,4 78,-18 C 52,-4 -40,-2 -105,-22 Z" fill="url(#bellyHighlight)" />

            <!-- Subtle Fur Texture Strokes on Body -->
            <g stroke="#693b1a" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.45" fill="none">
              <path d="M -95,-112 Q -82,-115 -72,-110" />
              <path d="M -62,-124 Q -46,-127 -35,-122" />
              <path d="M -25,-102 Q -10,-105 2,-100" />
              <path d="M -112,-82 Q -98,-85 -88,-79" />
              <path d="M -48,-76 Q -32,-78 -22,-73" />
              <path d="M 12,-88 Q 25,-90 36,-84" />
            </g>
            <g stroke="#e0a979" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.4" fill="none">
              <path d="M -78,-132 Q -62,-135 -48,-131" />
              <path d="M -28,-136 Q -10,-138 6,-133" />
              <path d="M 22,-124 Q 38,-125 50,-118" />
            </g>
          </g>

          <!-- Near-side Back Leg (Right) -->
          <g id="leg-back-near" transform="translate(-74, -12)">
            <!-- Haunch / Thigh -->
            <path d="M -38,-48
                     C -52,-24 -44,12 -24,38
                     L 14,38
                     C 22,16 24,-22 4,-48 Z"
                  fill="url(#legFrontGrad)" />
            <!-- Fur knee highlight -->
            <path d="M -28,-25 Q -18,-32 -6,-24" stroke="#d49764" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.45" />
            <!-- Near Back Paw -->
            <path d="M -26,33 C -28,43 -18,46 -4,46 L 22,46 C 30,46 31,37 20,33 Z" fill="#472713" />
            <ellipse cx="18" cy="42" rx="6.5" ry="4" fill="#2b1508" />
            <ellipse cx="6" cy="43" rx="6.5" ry="4" fill="#2b1508" />
            <ellipse cx="-6" cy="42" rx="6" ry="3.8" fill="#2b1508" />
          </g>

          <!-- Near-side Front Leg (Right) -->
          <g id="leg-front-near" transform="translate(36, -14)">
            <path d="M -20,-46
                     C -26,-18 -20,16 -12,40
                     L 16,40
                     C 22,16 20,-18 10,-46 Z"
                  fill="url(#legFrontGrad)" />
            <!-- Near Front Paw -->
            <path d="M -14,35 C -16,44 -6,47 8,47 L 28,47 C 35,47 36,38 25,34 Z" fill="#472713" />
            <ellipse cx="23" cy="43" rx="6.5" ry="4" fill="#2b1508" />
            <ellipse cx="11" cy="44" rx="6.5" ry="4" fill="#2b1508" />
            <ellipse cx="-1" cy="43" rx="6" ry="3.8" fill="#2b1508" />
          </g>

          <!-- NECK SCARF WRAP (Around Neck Collar) -->
          <g id="scarf-collar" transform="translate(66, -86)">
            <path d="M -28,12 C -12,28 24,30 42,14 C 48,4 44,-10 32,-16 C 12,-6 -14,-6 -28,12 Z" fill="url(#scarfGrad)" />
            <path d="M -20,14 C -4,24 22,25 36,12" stroke="url(#scarfStripeGrad)" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.9" />
          </g>

          <!-- CAPYBARA HEAD & ICONIC BOXY SNOUT -->
          <g id="capy-head" transform="translate(82, -132)">

            <!-- Far Ear (Left) -->
            <g id="ear-far" transform="translate(-8, -42)">
              <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="11" ry="15" transform="rotate(-18)" fill="#4d2c18" />
              <ellipse cx="1" cy="1" rx="6" ry="9" transform="rotate(-18)" fill="#2e180b" />
            </g>

            <!-- Head & Blunt Rectangular Snout Silhouette -->
            <path d="M -38,-22
                     C -42,-45 -20,-56 14,-55
                     C 48,-54 88,-48 110,-38
                     C 128,-30 134,-12 132,12
                     C 130,34 116,46 92,47
                     C 62,48 28,44 -2,38
                     C -28,32 -36,10 -38,-22 Z"
                  fill="url(#furHeadGrad)" />

            <!-- Iconic Dark Muzzle / Snout Patch -->
            <path d="M 76,-42
                     C 96,-42 115,-36 125,-25
                     C 134,-14 134,8 128,24
                     C 122,40 106,47 86,47
                     C 72,47 64,34 65,12
                     C 66,-14 64,-42 76,-42 Z"
                  fill="url(#snoutGrad)" />

            <!-- Bridge of Nose Highlight -->
            <path d="M -4,-51 C 32,-51 74,-45 102,-36" stroke="#e6b182" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.55" />

            <!-- Cheek Puff & Warm Blush -->
            <ellipse cx="52" cy="20" rx="18" ry="11" fill="#f48fb1" opacity="0.22" />
            <!-- Furry Jaw Tufts -->
            <path d="M -18,32 L -28,36 L -20,26 L -31,27 L -22,18" fill="#8b5229" />

            <!-- Near Ear (Right) -->
            <g id="ear-near" transform="translate(-24, -38)">
              <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="13" ry="17" transform="rotate(-24)" fill="#5c351d" />
              <ellipse cx="2" cy="1" rx="7.5" ry="10.5" transform="rotate(-24)" fill="#361c0c" />
              <path d="M -5,-9 C -2,-13 4,-12 6,-7" stroke="#9c6137" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" />
            </g>

            <!-- Nostril (Breathing Animation Target) -->
            <g id="nostril-group" transform="translate(108, -14)">
              <ellipse id="nostril-main" cx="0" cy="0" rx="6.5" ry="4.5" transform="rotate(22)" fill="#1c0d06" />
              <ellipse cx="-1.5" cy="-1" rx="2.2" ry="1.2" transform="rotate(22)" fill="#593825" opacity="0.6" />
              <!-- Far nostril hint -->
              <ellipse cx="19" cy="-3" rx="3.2" ry="2.5" transform="rotate(15)" fill="#1c0d06" />
            </g>

            <!-- Serene Chill Mouth / Whiskers -->
            <g id="mouth-group" transform="translate(105, 22)">
              <!-- Nose-to-lip philtrum cleft -->
              <path d="M 14,-20 C 15,-8 14,0 10,5" stroke="#1f0f07" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" />
              <!-- Unbothered chill smile curve -->
              <path id="mouth-curve" d="M -10,4 Q 2,10 10,5 Q 17,9 22,3" stroke="#1f0f07" stroke-width="2.8" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" />
              <!-- Subtle whiskers -->
              <g stroke="#d7a982" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.55" fill="none">
                <path d="M -4,-2 Q -18,0 -26,5" />
                <path d="M 0,4 Q -14,9 -22,15" />
                <path d="M 18,0 Q 28,2 34,7" />
              </g>
            </g>

            <!-- Chill Capybara Eye -->
            <g id="eye-group" transform="translate(36, -18)">
              <!-- Open / Half-Lidded Chill Eye -->
              <g id="eye-open">
                <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="8.5" ry="7.5" fill="#1e0f07" />
                <!-- Heavy relaxed upper eyelid -->
                <path d="M -10,-3 Q 0,-1 10,-4 L 10,-9 L -10,-9 Z" fill="#9c5e31" />
                <path d="M -10,-3 Q 0,-1 10,-4" stroke="#3b1f0e" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" />
                <!-- Specular eye shine -->
                <circle cx="3" cy="-1.5" r="2.3" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9" />
                <circle cx="-2.5" cy="2" r="1.1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.55" />
              </g>
              <!-- Closed / Happy Blink Eye -->
              <g id="eye-blink" style="display: none;">

(() => {

  // Themes (Sunset Vaporwave, Neo-Tokyo Night, Matcha Blossom Day)

  const clouds = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => ({

  const pylons = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => ({
    x: i * 220,
    height: 75 + (i % 3) * 28,
    type: i % 2
  }));

  const thrusterParticles = [];

    y: Math.random() * 680,
    size: 3.5 + Math.random() * 4.5,
    vy: 15 + Math.random() * 22,

  }));
  const speedLines = Array.from({ length: 18 }, () => ({
    x: Math.random() * 1400,
    y: 120 + Math.random() * 520,
    len: 65 + Math.random() * 110,
    alpha: 0.12 + Math.random() * 0.28
  }));
  const burstSparks = [];

  // Actions
  function triggerJump(spin = false) {
    if (!state.isJumping || state.jumpY > -40) {
      state.isJumping = true;
      state.jumpVy = spin ? -690 : -580;
      state.trickType = spin ? 'spin360' : 'kickflip';
      state.trickVel = spin ? 720 : -360;
      state.yuzuVy = -180;

      // Spawn burst shockwave & sparks under board
      for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
        const ang = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 22;
        const spd = 120 + Math.random() * 220;
        burstSparks.push({
          x: state.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 140,
          y: state.y + 42,
          vx: Math.cos(ang) * spd - state.speed * 2,
          vy: Math.sin(ang) * spd * 0.65,
          life: 1,
          decay: 1.6 + Math.random() * 0.8,
          color: i % 2 === 0 ? '#00f5d4' : '#ff2a85',
          size: 3 + Math.random() * 3.5
        });
      }

      repulsorRings.push({
        x: state.x,
        y: state.y + 52,
        rx: 65,
        ry: 14,
        maxRx: 210,
        alpha: 0.95,
        color: '#00f5d4'
      });
    }
  }

  function toggleBoost(forceState) {
    state.boost = typeof forceState === 'boolean' ? forceState : !state.boost;
    btnBoost.classList.toggle('active', state.boost);
    if (state.boost) {
      state.yuzuVy -= 70;
    }
  }

  function toggleVisor(forceState) {
    state.visorOn = typeof forceState === 'boolean' ? forceState : !state.visorOn;
    btnShades.classList.toggle('active', state.visorOn);
  }

  function cycleYuzu() {
    state.yuzuCount = (state.yuzuCount % 3) + 1;
    yuzu2.style.display = state.yuzuCount >= 2 ? 'block' : 'none';
    yuzu3.style.display = state.yuzuCount >= 3 ? 'block' : 'none';
    yuzuLabel.textContent = `Yuzu Stack: ${state.yuzuCount}`;
    state.yuzuOffsetY = -14;
    state.yuzuVy = -140;
  }

  function cycleTheme() {
    state.themeIdx = (state.themeIdx + 1) % THEMES.length;
    themeLabel.textContent = `Vibe: ${THEMES[state.themeIdx].name}`;
  }

  // Event Listeners
  btnJump.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    triggerJump(false);
  });

  btnSpin.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    triggerJump(true);
  });

  btnBoost.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    toggleBoost();
  });

  btnShades.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    toggleVisor();
  });

  btnYuzu.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    cycleYuzu();
  });

  btnTheme.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    cycleTheme();
  });

  stage.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    if (e.target.closest('#controls-bar')) return;
    triggerJump(e.shiftKey);
  });

  window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    state.pointerX = (e.clientX / vw - 0.5) * 2;
    state.pointerY = (e.clientY / vh - 0.5) * 2;
  });

  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      triggerJump(false);
    } else if (e.code === 'KeyF') {
      triggerJump(true);
    } else if (e.code === 'ShiftLeft' || e.code === 'ShiftRight' || e.code === 'ArrowRight') {
      toggleBoost(true);
    } else if (e.code === 'KeyV') {
      toggleVisor();
    } else if (e.code === 'KeyY') {
      cycleYuzu();
    } else if (e.code === 'KeyT') {
      cycleTheme();
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    if (e.code === 'ShiftLeft' || e.code === 'ShiftRight' || e.code === 'ArrowRight') {
      toggleBoost(false);
    }
  });

  // Helper to draw mountain silhouettes in logical coords
  function drawMountainLayer(ctx, offset, baseY, amp1, amp2, color) {
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-250, baseY + 200);
    for (let x = -250; x <= 1450; x += 35) {
      const worldX = x + offset;
      const h =
        Math.sin(worldX * 0.0045) * amp1 +
        Math.cos(worldX * 0.011) * amp2 +
        Math.sin(worldX * 0.023) * (amp2 * 0.45);
      ctx.lineTo(x, baseY - Math.abs(h));
    }
    ctx.lineTo(1450, baseY + 200);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Update Physics & DOM/SVG Transforms
  function update(dt) {
    state.t += dt;
    const t = state.t;

    // Speed & Boost interpolation
    state.targetSpeed = state.boost ? 96 : 44;
    state.speed += (state.targetSpeed - state.speed) * Math.min(1, dt * 5);
    const speedFactor = state.speed / 44;
    state.scrollDist += state.speed * dt * 11;

    // Autonomous micro-actions so the scene is lively hands-free
    state.autoActionTimer -= dt;
    if (state.autoActionTimer <= 0) {
      state.autoActionTimer = 5.5 + Math.random() * 4.5;
      if (!state.isJumping && Math.random() < 0.68) {
        triggerJump(Math.random() < 0.28);
      } else {
        state.earTwitchAngle = -24;
      }
    }

    // Smooth Hover Oscillation (dual harmonic sine wave)
    const hoverWave =
      Math.sin(t * 3.1) * 16 +
      Math.sin(t * 6.4 + 0.8) * 4.5;
    const hoverVy =
      Math.cos(t * 3.1) * 16 * 3.1 +
      Math.cos(t * 6.4 + 0.8) * 4.5 * 6.4;

    // Horizontal cruise sway
    const swayX = Math.sin(t * 1.45) * 24 + state.pointerX * 26;

    // Jump & Trick Physics
    if (state.isJumping) {
      state.jumpY += state.jumpVy * dt;
      state.jumpVy += 1480 * dt; // Gravity

      if (state.trickType === 'spin360') {
        state.trickAngle += state.trickVel * dt;
        if (state.trickAngle >= 360) {
          state.trickAngle = 360;
        }
      } else if (state.trickType === 'kickflip') {
        state.trickAngle = Math.sin(Math.min(1, Math.abs(state.jumpY) / 140) * Math.PI) * -16;
      }

      // Landing check
      if (state.jumpY >= 0) {
        state.jumpY = 0;
        state.jumpVy = 0;
        state.isJumping = false;
        state.trickAngle = 0;
        state.trickType = 'none';
        state.yuzuVy = 210; // Squash bounce on landing

        // Landing ring
        repulsorRings.push({
          x: state.x,
          y: 550,
          rx: 80,
          ry: 15,
          maxRx: 240,
          alpha: 0.85,
          color: '#ff2a85'
        });
      }
    } else {
      state.trickAngle *= Math.pow(0.05, dt);
    }

    state.x = state.baseX + swayX;
    state.y = state.baseY + hoverWave + state.jumpY;

    // Board pitch angle based on vertical velocity & boost forward lean
    const boostLean = state.boost ? 5.5 : 1.2;
    const pitchAngle =
      boostLean +
      (hoverVy * 0.065) +
      (state.jumpVy * 0.018);

    // Apply transform to main rider rig
    riderRig.setAttribute(
      'transform',
      `translate(${state.x.toFixed(2)}, ${state.y.toFixed(2)}) rotate(${pitchAngle.toFixed(2)})`
    );

    // Trick rotation around center of character+board
    trickSpinGroup.setAttribute(
      'transform',
      `rotate(${state.trickAngle.toFixed(2)}, 0, -35)`
    );

    // Capybara subtle breathing & knee suspension compression
    const breatheScaleY = 1 + Math.sin(t * 4.2) * 0.016 - (state.jumpVy * 0.00008);
    const breatheScaleX = 1 - Math.sin(t * 4.2) * 0.01;
    capyGroup.setAttribute(
      'transform',
      `scale(${breatheScaleX.toFixed(3)}, ${breatheScaleY.toFixed(3)})`
    );

    // Head secondary bob & chill nod
    const headBobY = -132 + Math.sin(t * 3.1 - 0.5) * 2.8;
    const headNod = Math.sin(t * 2.2) * 1.8 + (state.boost ? -3.5 : 0);
    capyHead.setAttribute(
      'transform',
      `translate(82, ${headBobY.toFixed(2)}) rotate(${headNod.toFixed(2)})`
    );

    // Nostril breathing flare
    const nostrilScale = 1 + Math.sin(t * 4.2) * 0.14 + (state.boost ? 0.18 : 0);
    nostrilGroup.setAttribute(
      'transform',
      `translate(108, -14) scale(${nostrilScale.toFixed(2)})`
    );

    // Natural Blinking & Happy Jump Squint
    state.blinkTimer -= dt;
    if (state.blinkTimer <= 0) {
      state.blinkDuration = 0.15;
      state.blinkTimer = 2.6 + Math.random() * 2.8;
    }
    if (state.blinkDuration > 0) {
      state.blinkDuration -= dt;
    }
    const showClosedEye = state.blinkDuration > 0 || state.isJumping;
    eyeOpen.style.display = showClosedEye ? 'none' : 'block';
    eyeBlink.style.display = showClosedEye ? 'block' : 'none';

    // Ear Twitching
    state.earTwitchTimer -= dt;
    if (state.earTwitchTimer <= 0) {
      state.earTwitchAngle = -20 - Math.random() * 14;
      state.earTwitchTimer = 1.6 + Math.random() * 3.2;
    }
    state.earTwitchAngle *= Math.pow(0.008, dt);
    earNear.setAttribute(
      'transform',
      `translate(-24, -38) rotate(${state.earTwitchAngle.toFixed(1)})`
    );
    earFar.setAttribute(
      'transform',
      `translate(-8, -42) rotate(${(-state.earTwitchAngle * 0.6).toFixed(1)})`
    );

    // Cyber Visor Animation (activates when visor toggled OR during Turbo Boost)
    const targetVisor = (state.visorOn || state.boost) ? 1 : 0;
    state.visorAlpha += (targetVisor - state.visorAlpha) * Math.min(1, dt * 10);
    const visorY = -18 - (1 - state.visorAlpha) * 26;
    cyberVisor.setAttribute('opacity', state.visorAlpha.toFixed(2));
    cyberVisor.setAttribute('transform', `translate(46, ${visorY.toFixed(1)})`);

    // Yuzu Tangerine Spring Physics on Capybara's Head
    const headAccelImpulse = (hoverVy * 0.15);
    const springForce = -state.yuzuOffsetY * 165 - state.yuzuVy * 11;
    state.yuzuVy += (springForce - headAccelImpulse) * dt;
    state.yuzuOffsetY += state.yuzuVy * dt;
    if (state.yuzuOffsetY > 3) {
      state.yuzuOffsetY = 3;
      state.yuzuVy *= -0.45;
    }
    state.yuzuTilt = Math.sin(t * 5.2) * 4 + (state.yuzuOffsetY * 0.6);
    yuzuStackGroup.setAttribute(
      'transform',
      `translate(22, ${(-56 + state.yuzuOffsetY).toFixed(2)}) rotate(${state.yuzuTilt.toFixed(2)})`
    );

    // Dynamic Flowing Scarf Wave
    const waveFreq = t * (state.boost ? 18 : 10);
    const w1 = Math.sin(waveFreq) * (state.boost ? 18 : 10);
    const w2 = Math.cos(waveFreq - 1.3) * (state.boost ? 26 : 15);
    const tailLen = state.boost ? -195 : -162;

    scarfTailMain.setAttribute(
      'd',
      `M 62,-68 C -10,${(-72 + w1).toFixed(1)} -90,${(-48 + w2).toFixed(1)} ${tailLen},${(-56 - w1).toFixed(1)} ` +
      `C ${tailLen + 10},${(-34 - w1).toFixed(1)} ${tailLen + 14},${(-28 - w2).toFixed(1)} ${tailLen + 4},${(-26 - w1).toFixed(1)} ` +
      `C -85,${(-22 + w2).toFixed(1)} -10,${(-42 + w1).toFixed(1)} 60,-42 Z`
    );
    scarfTailStripe.setAttribute(
      'd',
      `M 56,-55 C -15,${(-58 + w1).toFixed(1)} -88,${(-36 + w2).toFixed(1)} ${tailLen + 10},${(-42 - w1).toFixed(1)}`
    );
    scarfTailBack.setAttribute(
      'd',
      `M 55,-72 C -15,${(-82 - w1 * 0.7).toFixed(1)} -85,${(-65 + w2 * 0.8).toFixed(1)} ${tailLen + 18},${(-76 + w1).toFixed(1)} ` +
      `C -90,${(-45 + w2 * 0.6).toFixed(1)} -25,${(-52 - w1 * 0.5).toFixed(1)} 50,-48 Z`
    );

    // Rear Jet Plume Pulse
    const plumeScaleX = (state.boost ? 1.85 : 1.0) + Math.sin(t * 38) * 0.16;
    const plumeScaleY = (state.boost ? 1.35 : 0.95) + Math.cos(t * 44) * 0.12;
    rearJetPlume.setAttribute(
      'transform',
      `translate(-195, 34) scale(${plumeScaleX.toFixed(2)}, ${plumeScaleY.toFixed(2)})`
    );

    // Repulsor Pulsing & Rail Node Animation
    const repulseScale = 1 + Math.sin(t * 28) * 0.18;
    repulsorGlowRear.setAttribute('rx', (30 * repulseScale).toFixed(1));
    repulsorGlowFront.setAttribute('rx', (30 * repulseScale).toFixed(1));

    for (let i = 0; i < railNodes.length; i++) {
      const pulse = ((t * (state.boost ? 4.5 : 2.2) + i * 0.25) % 1);
      const xPos = -155 + pulse * 310;
      const yArc = 6.2 - Math.pow(xPos / 165, 2) * 9.5;
      railNodes[i].setAttribute('cx', xPos.toFixed(1));
      railNodes[i].setAttribute('cy', yArc.toFixed(1));
    }

    // Ground Shadow & Neon Reflection Scaling with Altitude
    const altitudeFactor = Math.max(0.28, 1 - Math.abs(state.y - 455) / 260);
    groundShadowGroup.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${state.x.toFixed(1)}, 585)`);
    groundNeonPool.setAttribute('rx', (245 * altitudeFactor).toFixed(1));
    groundNeonPool.setAttribute('opacity', (0.85 * altitudeFactor).toFixed(2));
    groundDarkCore.setAttribute('rx', (155 * altitudeFactor).toFixed(1));
    groundDarkCore.setAttribute('opacity', (0.68 * altitudeFactor).toFixed(2));

    // Update Telemetry HUD
    const displaySpeed = Math.round(state.speed + Math.sin(t * 3.5) * 2);
    const displayAlt = (1.25 - (state.y - 455) * 0.008).toFixed(2);
    hudSpeed.textContent = `${displaySpeed} KM/H`;
    hudAlt.textContent = `${displayAlt} M`;

    // Spawn Continuous Thruster & Repulsor Particles
    const rad = (pitchAngle * Math.PI) / 180;
    const cosA = Math.cos(rad);
    const sinA = Math.sin(rad);

    // Exhaust particles from rear nozzle (-200, 34) relative to rig
    const nozzleWorldX = state.x + (-200 * cosA - 34 * sinA);
    const nozzleWorldY = state.y + (-200 * sinA + 34 * cosA);

    const spawnCount = state.boost ? 3 : 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < spawnCount; i++) {
      thrusterParticles.push({
        x: nozzleWorldX + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10,
        y: nozzleWorldY + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8,
        vx: -(240 + Math.random() * 180) * speedFactor,
        vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 45,
        size: (state.boost ? 7 : 5) + Math.random() * 5,
        life: 1,
        decay: 1.8 + Math.random() * 1.1,
        color: Math.random() < 0.55 ? '#00f5d4' : (Math.random() < 0.5 ? '#ff2a85' : '#fee440')
      });
    }

    // Periodic downward anti-gravity rings from front & rear repulsors
    if (Math.random() < (state.boost ? 0.45 : 0.28)) {
      const isFront = Math.random() < 0.5;
      const localX = isFront ? 95 : -95;
      const localY = 50;
      repulsorRings.push({
        x: state.x + (localX * cosA - localY * sinA),
        y: state.y + (localX * sinA + localY * cosA),
        rx: 18,
        ry: 4.5,
        maxRx: 52,
        alpha: 0.72,
        color: isFront ? '#00f5d4' : '#38bdf8'
      });
    }

    // Update Thruster Particles
    for (let i = thrusterParticles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = thrusterParticles[i];
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.life -= p.decay * dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) thrusterParticles.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // Update Repulsor Rings
    for (let i = repulsorRings.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const r = repulsorRings[i];
      r.y += 95 * dt;
      r.x -= state.speed * 2.2 * dt;
      r.rx += (r.maxRx - r.rx) * 4.5 * dt;
      r.ry = r.rx * 0.22;
      r.alpha -= 1.45 * dt;
      if (r.alpha <= 0) repulsorRings.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // Update Burst Sparks
    for (let i = burstSparks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const s = burstSparks[i];
      s.x += s.vx * dt;
      s.y += s.vy * dt;
      s.vy += 380 * dt;
      s.life -= s.decay * dt;
      if (s.life <= 0) burstSparks.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // Update Clouds, Pylons, Petals & Speed Lines
    for (const c of clouds) {
      c.x -= c.speed * speedFactor * dt;
      if (c.x + c.w < -250) c.x = 1480;
    }

    for (const p of pylons) {
      p.x -= state.speed * 5.2 * dt;
      if (p.x < -220) p.x += pylons.length * 220;
    }

    for (const petal of ambientPetals) {
      petal.x -= (state.speed * 4.2 + Math.sin(t * 2 + petal.phase) * 20) * dt;
      petal.y += (petal.vy + Math.cos(t * 2.5 + petal.phase) * 14) * dt;
      petal.rot += petal.vRot * dt;
      if (petal.x < -150) petal.x = 1350;
      if (petal.y > 680) petal.y = -20;
    }

    for (const line of speedLines) {
      line.x -= state.speed * 18 * dt;
      if (line.x + line.len < -200) {
        line.x = 1350 + Math.random() * 250;
        line.y = 80 + Math.random() * 540;
      }
    }
  }

  // Render Background & Parallax World
  function renderBackground() {
    const theme = THEMES[state.themeIdx];
    const t = state.t;

    bgCtx.save();
    bgCtx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    // Horizon line in viewport coordinates
    const horizonScreenY = viewOffsetY + 515 * viewScale;

    // 1. Full-screen Sky Gradient
    const skyGrad = bgCtx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, horizonScreenY);
    skyGrad.addColorStop(0, theme.skyTop);
    skyGrad.addColorStop(0.45, theme.skyMid);
    skyGrad.addColorStop(0.82, theme.skyLow);
    skyGrad.addColorStop(1, theme.skyHorizon);
    bgCtx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
    bgCtx.fillRect(0, 0, vw, horizonScreenY + 2);

    // 2. Full-screen Ground Plane
    const groundGrad = bgCtx.createLinearGradient(0, horizonScreenY, 0, vh);
    groundGrad.addColorStop(0, theme.groundTop);
    groundGrad.addColorStop(1, theme.groundBot);
    bgCtx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
    bgCtx.fillRect(0, horizonScreenY, vw, vh - horizonScreenY);

    // Switch to logical 1200x750 coordinate transform matching SVG
    bgCtx.setTransform(
      dpr * viewScale,
      0,
      0,
      dpr * viewScale,
      dpr * viewOffsetX,
      dpr * viewOffsetY
    );

    // 3. Twinkling Stars
    for (const s of stars) {
      const twinkle = 0.35 + 0.65 * Math.sin(t * 2.4 + s.phase);
      bgCtx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${twinkle.toFixed(2)})`;
      bgCtx.beginPath();
      bgCtx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      bgCtx.fill();
    }

    // 4. Giant Synthwave Sun / Moon with Horizon Scanlines
    const sunX = 600;
    const sunY = 305;
    const sunR = 148;
    const sunGrad = bgCtx.createLinearGradient(sunX, sunY - sunR, sunX, sunY + sunR);
    sunGrad.addColorStop(0, theme.sunColorTop);
    sunGrad.addColorStop(1, theme.sunColorBot);

    bgCtx.save();
    bgCtx.shadowColor = theme.sunColorBot;
    bgCtx.shadowBlur = 42;
    bgCtx.fillStyle = sunGrad;
    bgCtx.beginPath();
    bgCtx.arc(sunX, sunY, sunR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    bgCtx.fill();
    bgCtx.restore();

    // Retro horizontal slices in lower half of sun
    bgCtx.fillStyle = theme.skyLow;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const sliceY = sunY + 22 + i * 20;
      const sliceH = 3 + i * 1.7;
      bgCtx.fillRect(sunX - sunR - 10, sliceY, (sunR + 10) * 2, sliceH);
    }

    // 5. Drifting Soft Clouds
    for (const c of clouds) {
      bgCtx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)';
      bgCtx.beginPath();
      bgCtx.roundRect(c.x, c.y, c.w, c.h, c.h * 0.5);
      bgCtx.fill();
    }

    // 6. Parallax Mountain Ranges
    drawMountainLayer(bgCtx, state.scrollDist * 0.08, 515, 95, 42, theme.mountainFar);
    drawMountainLayer(bgCtx, state.scrollDist * 0.22, 515, 58, 28, theme.mountainNear);

    // 7. Roadside Neon Pylons / Lantern Pillars
    for (const p of pylons) {
      const topY = 515 - p.height;
      bgCtx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
      bgCtx.fillRect(p.x - 4, topY, 8, p.height);

      // Glowing neon strip on pylon
      bgCtx.fillStyle = p.type === 0 ? '#00f5d4' : '#ff2a85';
      bgCtx.fillRect(p.x - 1.5, topY + 6, 3, p.height - 16);
    }

    // 8. Perspective Hover Highway & Scrolling Grid
    const horizonY = 515;
    bgCtx.strokeStyle = theme.gridColor;
    bgCtx.lineWidth = 1.6;

    // Horizontal perspective lines
    for (let i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
      const p = Math.pow(i / 9, 1.75);
      const y = horizonY + p * 260;
      bgCtx.beginPath();
      bgCtx.moveTo(-400, y);
      bgCtx.lineTo(1600, y);
      bgCtx.stroke();
    }

    // Scrolling perspective radial lines
    const gridSpacing = 90;
    const gridShift = (state.scrollDist * 0.85) % gridSpacing;
    for (let x = -600 - gridShift; x <= 1800; x += gridSpacing) {
      const dx = x - 600;
      bgCtx.beginPath();
      bgCtx.moveTo(600 + dx * 0.22, horizonY);
      bgCtx.lineTo(600 + dx * 1.45, 790);
      bgCtx.stroke();
    }

    // Glowing Hover Lane Center Dashes
    const dashPeriod = 180;
    const dashOffset = (state.scrollDist * 1.4) % dashPeriod;
    bgCtx.fillStyle = theme.roadGlow;
    for (let x = -300 - dashOffset; x < 1550; x += dashPeriod) {
      bgCtx.beginPath();
      bgCtx.roundRect(x, 582, 78, 5, 2.5);
      bgCtx.fill();
    }

    // Bright Horizon Divider Beam
    bgCtx.strokeStyle = '#00f5d4';
    bgCtx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    bgCtx.beginPath();
    bgCtx.moveTo(-400, horizonY);
    bgCtx.lineTo(1600, horizonY);
    bgCtx.stroke();

    bgCtx.restore();
  }

  // Render Foreground Particles & Dynamic FX
  function renderFX() {
    const theme = THEMES[state.themeIdx];

    fxCtx.save();
    fxCtx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    fxCtx.clearRect(0, 0, vw, vh);

    // Align strictly with SVG 1200x750 coordinate space
    fxCtx.setTransform(
      dpr * viewScale,
      0,
      0,
      dpr * viewScale,
      dpr * viewOffsetX,
      dpr * viewOffsetY
    );

    // 1. Repulsor Anti-Gravity Rings
    for (const r of repulsorRings) {
      fxCtx.strokeStyle = r.color;
      fxCtx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, r.alpha);
      fxCtx.lineWidth = 2.4;
      fxCtx.beginPath();
      fxCtx.ellipse(r.x, r.y, r.rx, r.ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      fxCtx.stroke();
    }

    // 2. Thruster Plasma Exhaust Particles
    for (const p of thrusterParticles) {
      fxCtx.fillStyle = p.color;
      fxCtx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life * 0.88);
      fxCtx.beginPath();
      fxCtx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      fxCtx.fill();
    }

    // 3. Trick Burst Sparks
    for (const s of burstSparks) {
      fxCtx.fillStyle = s.color;
      fxCtx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, s.life);
      fxCtx.beginPath();
      fxCtx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size * s.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      fxCtx.fill();
    }

    // 4. Floating Blossom Petals / Glowing Fireflies
    fxCtx.fillStyle = theme.petalColor;
    for (const petal of ambientPetals) {
      fxCtx.save();
      fxCtx.translate(petal.x, petal.y);
      fxCtx.rotate(petal.rot);
      fxCtx.globalAlpha = 0.72;
      fxCtx.beginPath();
      fxCtx.ellipse(0, 0, petal.size, petal.size * 0.55, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      fxCtx.fill();
      fxCtx.restore();
    }

    // 5. High-Speed Wind Streaks
    const speedAlphaMul = state.boost ? 1.85 : 0.75;
    fxCtx.strokeStyle = '#e0fbfc';
    fxCtx.lineWidth = state.boost ? 2.2 : 1.3;
    for (const line of speedLines) {
      fxCtx.globalAlpha = Math.min(0.75, line.alpha * speedAlphaMul);
      fxCtx.beginPath();
      fxCtx.moveTo(line.x, line.y);
      fxCtx.lineTo(line.x + line.len * (state.boost ? 1.6 : 1), line.y);
      fxCtx.stroke();
    }

    fxCtx.restore();
  }

  // Main Animation Loop
  let lastTime = performance.now();
  function animate(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastTime) / 1000);
    lastTime = now;

    update(dt);
    renderBackground();
    renderFX();

    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
})();
</script>
